about_the_game:
Take Back the Backyard

Nettle Slasher is a simple straightforward slasher about clearing a summer garden that's been completely taken over by stinging nettles. You play as a teenager on vacation, armed with all kinds of makeshift weapons made from sticks: melee and ranged, just like in the backyard games of childhood.

There’s no grand story, no complicated systems. Just grab a stick and start cutting down weeds.

It’s the kind of game you play when you want to turn your brain off for a while. Whether you're in for ten minutes or an hour, the goal is simple: take down the nettles, explore the garden, and maybe step past the old gate into something a bit darker.

But make sure you're back before dinnertime!

Key Features

• A wide range of stick-based weapons
From simple branches to blasters, every weapon is imagined and improvised. Each one feels a little different. Try melee or ranged tools depending on your style.

• A backyard turned overgrown battlefield
Move through tall nettles, blocked paths and forgotten corners. The garden is dense, messy, and full of surprises.

• No pressure, no grind
No missions, no timers, no scoring. It’s a game you can pick up anytime and play at your own pace.

• Optional exploration
You can stay in the safe parts of the yard, or step through the old gate and see what’s beyond.

• Built around childhood imagination
It's a simple fantasy: hitting plants with a stick and calling it a mission. Now you can do it without leaving the house.

Why Play Nettle Slasher?

• Instant, satisfying gameplay
No long intros, no tutorials. Jump in and start cutting weeds.

• Fits into short play sessions
Perfect for breaks, after work, or whenever you need to zone out for a bit.

• Unique and lighthearted tone
Not heroic, not epic. Just fun and grounded in a familiar feeling.

• Low system requirements
Fast to install, quick to launch, easy to run.

• Made by a small indie team
Built with care and focus on keeping things simple and enjoyable.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: Slash, poke, and blast your way through a backyard overrun with stinging nettles. Armed with makeshift stick weapons, reclaim the garden like you're a kid again. Step past the old mysterious gate into a place best left undisturbed – but make sure you're back before dinnertime... in one piece.
